speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.care_worker_to_service_recipient: Respectful adult speech; use आप and नाम + जी where a name is supplied. Keep the care role distinct from nursing, medical and therapy roles.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.colleagues: Respectful आप; no invented familiarity, seniority or kinship.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.supervisor_medical_professional_family: Use the explicit role; preserve the particular recipient of each report and scope of permission.
speaker_listener_roles_and_relationship.grammatical_gender: Do not infer gender from Japanese names. Prefer neutral first-person and impersonal constructions. Honorific plural grammatical forms do not assert an age or gender.

address_forms_and_conditions.default: आप; surname + जी in exposition when the source uses surname + さん.
address_forms_and_conditions.explicit_learning_target: Preserve requested forms such as हारुको-सान, distinguishing सान and चान; never substitute a kinship term.
address_forms_and_conditions.permission: क्या ... कर सकते हैं?, क्या ... दूँ? or natural respectful wording with the same scope of consent.
address_forms_and_conditions.relationship_changes: Change address only if the Japanese context or person preference explicitly warrants it.

names_honorifics_and_unknown_gender_age.names: Use stable Devanagari transliteration: तनाका, मोरिकावा हारुको, हासेबे केनइचि, ओनोदेरा फुमि, किशिमोतो मिसाकि.
names_honorifics_and_unknown_gender_age.unknown: No added age, gender, marital or family relationship. Retain बेटी only where 娘 is explicit.
names_honorifics_and_unknown_gender_age.honorifics: Use जी in ordinary prose; retain Japanese honorific sounds when address itself is tested.

register_and_social_phrases.tone: Warm, respectful, adult, clear and connected teaching prose.
register_and_social_phrases.greetings: Translate communicative function; よろしくお願いします in this first introduction becomes आपसे मिलकर अच्छा लगा.
register_and_social_phrases.thanks_refusal_clarification: Use natural जी, धन्यवाद, क्षमा कीजिए and कृपया, without adding promises or clinical advice.
register_and_social_phrases.completeness: Preserve reasons, conditions, uncertainty, negation, sequence, roles, recipients and limits; do not compress to notes.

preferred_terminology_by_concept_id.glossary_reuse: Identical Japanese glossary paragraphs use identical Hindi wording within the unit and must be reused in future weeks.

headings_punctuation_and_script_fonts.script: Devanagari Hindi; retain Japanese terms/readings only in vocabulary learning targets.
headings_punctuation_and_script_fonts.punctuation: Use । for sentences, ? for questions and clear quoted target address forms.
headings_punctuation_and_script_fonts.headings: Brief natural Hindi headings; full paragraphs and dialogue turns stay intact.
headings_punctuation_and_script_fonts.fonts: Use existing approved presentation with Devanagari-capable fallback; no UI/font edits in this batch; actual-device shaping not reviewed.
